item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
The first public release.
- Press ⌥⌘Space, ask, read, press Esc. The card slides in from the right edge and gets out of the way. - Runs your own `claude` with your login, settings, skills and connectors. Answers come first, with a few "worth knowing" bullets. - One session all day, reset with ⌘N or at 5 AM. Nothing is saved to disk. - After 3 quiet minutes it opens as just the field; drag the bottom edge down for earlier questions. - Markdown renders while it streams: lists, tables, code, alerts, footnotes and math. - Updates itself through Sparkle, quietly: a dot on ✦ when an update is ready.
